answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 48536 Country: Bangladesh Title: Eating Haram Question: If a person mistakenly has eaten something haram, then if he repents and donates the equivalent amount money, will it be perfect, or else what he has to do? Answer ID: 48536 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1365/1365/M=11/1434) He should do taubah and istighfar extensively and should take care in future that such mistake is not repeated. It is better if he offers two rakahs of salah taubah and seeks forgiveness from Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
